source.title: Ermes talks about the Genadi vs Morozov supermatch
source.description:
Ermes Gasparini and Engin Terzi have talked about the Genadi vs Morozov supermatch and they both believe that Genadi has more endurance than Morozov. In addition Ermes and Engin compared Genadi's and Devon's endurance.
